subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Can a Feishu-capable maintainer run live current-main WebSocket diagnostics before this issue is closed or turned into a repair job?
rationale: Source and dependency inspection show the intended handler path, but the reported live symptom cannot be confirmed or attributed without Feishu credentials and redacted runtime logs.

options.title: Run live diagnostics
options.body: Use a real Feishu/Lark app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled and capture redacted SDK/gateway logs through dispatcher, parser, and routing boundaries before deciding the fix shape.

options.title: Treat merged runtime fixes as sufficient
options.body: Close only if a maintainer can confirm the reporter's configuration now receives message events on current main or a shipped release.

options.title: Route as app configuration
options.body: Use this only if live diagnostics show Feishu Developer Console subscription, scope, or app publication state is the sole cause.

recommendation.title: Run live diagnostics
recommendation.body: Use a real Feishu/Lark app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled and capture redacted SDK/gateway logs through dispatcher, parser, and routing boundaries before deciding the fix shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintenance contact, making them the best routing signal for credentialed Feishu behavior.
